news.title: Lekjaa: Morocco to host 2030 World Cup final
news.lede: RABAT: Moroccan Football Federation president Fouzi Lekjaa has claimed that Morocco will host the 2030 FIFA World Cup final at the planned Hassan II Stadium in Ben Slimane, near Casablanca. FIFA has yet to officially decide which stadium will stage the final, with Morocco and Spain competing to host the tournament’s showpiece match. According to Spanish news agency EFE, Lekjaa made the claim during a political event in Bouznika, saying that Ben Slimane Province would have the honor of hosting the 2030 World Cup final. Located about 60 kilometers from Casablanca, Ben Slimane is home to the Hassan II Stadium, which is currently under construction.

news.title: Morocco and Spain joust over which will host 2030 World Cup final amid border crisis
news.lede: CASABLANCA, Morocco: Morocco and Spain are arguing over the right to host the 2030 World Cup final — with besieged FIFA boss Gianni Infantino hovering backstage. FIFA has yet to officially announce which country will host the biggest match of the biggest event in soccer. And even though the 2026 edition just finished with Spain winning the title this summer, Moroccan and Spanish officials are staking their claim on the next final. The tussle over the soccer match also comes with Spain still reeling from a massive border crossing by tens of thousands of migrants who pushed through the frontier from Morocco into the north African Spanish enclave in late July.

news.title: Casablanca will host 2030 World Cup final, says Moroccan federation chief
news.lede: RABAT: The 2030 World Cup ‌final will be held in Casablanca, the President of the Royal Moroccan Football Federation was reported as saying by Spanish news agency EFE on Thursday. Soccer’s world governing body FIFA has yet to announce the venue of the final, with Spain and Morocco in a heated battle to host soccer’s biggest showpiece match. “The province of Benslimane will have ‌the honour of ‌hosting the 2030 World Cup ‌final,” Fouzi Lekjaa told a political party event in Bouznika, Morocco on Thursday, EFE reported. Benslimane is a city 60km from Casablanca and the site of the $12-billion Hassan II stadium, which is being built for the World Cup with a projected capacity of 115,000.

news.lede: THE 2030 World Cup final destination has seemingly been leaked, despite an announcement not yet having been made. Royal Moroccan Football Federation president Fouzi Lekjaa has confidently claimed the Grand Stade Hassan II in Casablanca suburb Benslimane will host the biggest game in world football.
